title: spec: declare the closed set of expression-bindable text keys (`title` / `label` / `value` / `description`) — the contract half of objectui#4795 Direction 1
body:
Commissioned by maintainer ruling (2026-08-18, live PM chat with the triage seat, session `session_01EUZUjvnLsqwHVkXkTv8TKQ`). The 2026-08-17 ruling on objectui#4795 (comment 5312061331) deferred Direction 1 behind a named restart condition — *"the first real schema-authored dashboard need hits the gap"* — and pre-defined the reopening terms. Today the maintainer ruled the condition met by product intent, verbatim: 「"AI 一句话生成会动的仪表盘"或"用户在 Studio 自助配仪表盘"…这个是仪表盘的基本需求吧?」— a live dashboard authored in pure metadata is a **basic** requirement, not a speculative one. Direction 1 therefore reopens now, on the 08-17 ruling's own terms.

## Scope (spec half — this card)

Declare in `@objectstack/spec` a **closed** vocabulary of expression-bindable text keys — `title`, `label`, `value`, `description` — per the 08-17 terms: *"the key set is declared in `@objectstack/spec`/types as a closed enum, never inferred"*. The declaration must make it mechanically answerable, per component schema, which keys the renderer's evaluation memo evaluates — so the objectui half can consume it rather than hard-code a twin list. Which component schemas carry which of the four keys is part of this card's design surface (statistic `value`, card `title`/`description`, button `label` are the measured motivating cases on objectui#4795).

## What this is NOT

- ⛔ Direction 2 (merging the `props` envelope into the node) stays permanently rejected (08-17 ruling).
- The objectui evaluation-memo implementation is the downstream half — it rides objectui#4795, `Blocked-by:` this card.
- The render-time loud diagnostic (Direction 3) is already shipped (objectui PR #5129) and is unaffected.

## Dispatch constraints

**Clause-②: yes** — this widens the authoring accept surface (keys that were inert text become evaluated contract), so the dispatch is contract-review tier per the mandatory clause, and the `needs:contract-review` loop applies at ACCEPT. Cross-links: objectui#4795 (measurements + the two rulings) · objectui#5123 (`properties` precedence, ruled 2026-08-18) · objectui#4786 (the teaching-face history).
